THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE          41

[Photograph: Reproduction of a catalog page. Text reads:

10

1.  Carrying fire-arms is positively forbidden, and also intoxicating beverages of any kind.

2.  All persons boarding will be held strictly amenable to the rules of the house, and all those in private houses as well as during school hours.

3.  No pupil having been expelled will be admitted again during the term in which he is expelled.

4.  The standing of each pupil will be kept both as to deportment and studies.

All assistants are required to aid in the execution of these rules.

EXPENSES.

The session is divided into two terms of sixteen and twenty-two weeks respectively. Expenses per term of—

        Collegiate Department, per month          $5 00
        Preparatory Department, per month          $3 50[?]
        Collegiate Course, per month          $1 00[?]
        Primary Department, per month first and fourth year          $2 00
        Incidental Fee per Session, in advance          $1 00

Pupils will be charged from the date of entrance, and no deduction will be made except in cases of protracted sickness of at least two weeks.

Public declamations and Essay writings will be required when pupil leaves school. All who can, will be expected to pay monthly. Those who cannot pay monthly, we have a boarding system.

When payment can not be made at the end of each month, a ten or per cent. will be required at the end of each term.]
notes: Printed page 41. Page is a reproduction of a catalog page showing school rules and expenses. Some fee amounts are uncertain due to image quality.
